messages:
Maya (PM): Quick callout — we need to finalize the onboarding sample UI for next week's release. Two options: compact horizontal pill strip (no images) or richer preview cards (image + blurb). Also a consent toggle for 'help improve templates'. Thoughts?

Ivy (Design): Leaning pills — keeps checklist visible on first run. Cards push content down on mobile. I'll mock keyboard focus and hover states.

Carlos (Eng): Pills are cheaper to ship. Role-suggestion can come from signup metadata (server flag). Telemetry toggle default must be OFF per Leah.

Priya (Accessibility): Pills must support horizontal arrow navigation and have clear focus outlines. Consent toggle needs accessible label and aria-describedby for the privacy link. Color contrast checks needed.

Leah (Legal): Confirmed — telemetry opt-in only. Copy must disclose role inference if we auto-suggest templates. Provide privacy link.

Maya (PM): Decision: ship compact pill strip + a "View preview" panel for users who want more detail. Telemetry toggle default OFF with link. Action items: Ivy update comps by Tue, Carlos spike for role-suggest Mon, Priya add checklist, Leah provide consent copy. @ConsoleBot make task DD-2833.

ConsoleBot: Task created — DD-2833 "Onboarding: compact sample pill strip + opt-in telemetry" assigned to Maya, Ivy, Carlos, Priya, Leah. Due: 2026-04-05.
